artifact_review: The Router reported no artifacts, which aligns with the Perceptual Quality Auditor's finding of no graphic distortions. The geometric depth map confirms solid grounding. Therefore, while the pose confidence is low, the structural integrity appears visually sound. I am downgrading the severity of the pose signal but noting it as a minor structural ambiguity.
